description: Use this to stop copying inbound mail to one external address. Requires auth and inbox_update. Inputs: inbox_id (required), destination_id (required; ifd_ id or the email). Returns {id, email, deleted:true}. An unknown destination is HTTP 404 forwarding_destination_not_found. Another account's inbox is HTTP 404 inbox_not_found. Does not return a confirmation code.

destination_id.description: Destination id (ifd_…) or the external email address to remove.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_remove_forwarding

deleted.description: True when the object was deleted.

email.description: The external address that was removed.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

title: Remove auto-forward destination
